title: Glittereyed his rufous skull close to
html_source:
This is external narrative and unusual for the start of this chapter. Not since chapter 2: Nestor have we had so much external dialog.

It is part of the parallels to the stage this chapter presents (Shipe, A.J. The Labyrinthe, Bloom’s Literary Times).

The office is the stage; Stephen and Joyce direct it.

He came a step forward
Smile, smile, Cranly’s smile
he corantoed off
Mr. Best entered.
